claims.claim: Players experience technical issues including enemies hitting through walls, jank physics during parkour, and online matchmaking disconnects.

citations.review_text:
Fun, ALTHOUGH... Bear in mind this is still VERY early access so you might experience enemies hitting through walls, VERY jank physics (which makes the obligatory parkour sections a nightmare), getting kicked out the game when playing online for no real reason other than just because and so on and so forth...
Still enjoyable as it is.

Amazing, affordable and actively updated game. It's fun for both solo and multiplayer playthroughs, with incredibly high replayability. Overall a solid 8/10.


Bug found: 
Player's death head and certain weapons will sometimes get stuck in wall with no way to be resolved.


Recommendation:
1. Cosmetics are a good update, however, considering higher-rarity cosmetic boxes have way lower spawn rates, and players currently have no other in-game goal to grind for, petition to allow players to get higher-rarity cosmetics once every cosmetic in one rarity has been unlocked, rather than just in-game currency compensation.


2. The game has no backup option for players, hence the monsters RNG becomes insanely valued, especially at higher levels. 
There are certainly some interactions that need to be resolved:

2.1 Improve Upscream's tossing attack such that it does not throw players into deadly pits.

2.2 Hidden will sometimes kidnap players straight to Hunter, which is CRAZILY unfair. A great way to solve this would be making Hidden's movement sounds immune to Hunter's detection. 

or just let us backup bruh

Adorable, hilarious, and really fun game.  REPO, PEAK, and Headliners are the best of the friendslop genre so far imo.  

There are a couple of really irritating mechanics though, like the prevalence of insta-kill pits in extraction rooms, but most annoyingly how easily the cart can be lost for the remainder of the mission, making every single piece of loot an exhausting pain to carry around.  Allowing the cart to respawn back at the start when destroyed, either immediately or on a timer, would make my friend group a lot readier to play this again; currently we heave a collective groan and shelve REPO for another few months every time the cart goes crunch or falls in a pit.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that items carried in-hand feature physics simulation rather than remaining static.

citations.review_text:
YIPPIES

One of the best multiplayer horror games up to date for sure. Its funny and entertaining with friends and the horror aspect shines a lot more during a solo run. You might even be on the edge of your seat if there is only one friend alive. If the game isnt fun, its because you or your friends aren't. The devs also listen to the community and don't just patch things out cause the community enjoys them, but instead, treat it like a feature (unlike other devs who may patch things even though they're fun!)

Also, peak physics.

NOT YIPPIES

My only gripe is, that its just like with minecraft, those two games have the trickiest first-person POV's ever. Now, with minecraft the issue is mitigated due to the FOV change but if you have motion sickness, you won't be able to play for long due to the sickness it can cause.

What I also wish could be better is definitely how strength is determined here. If a players head gets stuck somewhere and a strength zero guy tries to get that head, they can't get it. Neither can the strength 5 guy. Now that doesn't make sense.

Overall, I completely recommend it.

The main hook of this game (for me) is that the items in your hand are not just static but have physics. The teamwork in this game is a work of art, having to carry a piano with your friend while trying not to break it on the way is why it’s the best friendship game right after Lethal Company

R.E.P.O. – najlepsza gra kooperacyjna, w jaką grałem!

R.E.P.O. to zdecydowanie jedna z najlepszych gier, jakie miałem okazję wypróbować. Już od pierwszej rozgrywki wciąga niesamowitym klimatem, świetnym poczuciem humoru i ogromną dawką emocji. To połączenie horroru, współpracy i fizyki sprawia, że każda rozgrywka jest zupełnie inna i nigdy się nie nudzi. Gra pozwala bawić się nawet w 6 osób, dzięki czemu najlepiej smakuje ze znajomymi.

Największym plusem gry jest fizyka przedmiotów. Każdy przedmiot zachowuje się realistycznie, więc trzeba uważać podczas przenoszenia cennych rzeczy. Czasami wystarczy jeden nieostrożny ruch, aby wszystko się rozsypało, a innym razem dochodzi do tak zabawnych sytuacji, że cała drużyna wybucha śmiechem. To właśnie te nieprzewidywalne momenty sprawiają, że chce się grać godzinami.

Świetnie zaprojektowane są także potwory. Każdy przeciwnik zachowuje się inaczej i wymaga innej strategii. Dzięki temu gra nie polega tylko na uciekaniu, ale również na współpracy, planowaniu i podejmowaniu szybkich decyzji. Klimat jest niesamowity – raz jest strasznie, a chwilę później wszyscy śmieją się z absurdalnej sytuacji.

Grafika, mimo że nie jest ultrarealistyczna, idealnie pasuje do stylu gry. Oświetlenie, dźwięki i mroczne lokacje tworzą napięcie, przez co cały czas czuć, że za chwilę może wydarzyć się coś niebezpiecznego. Muzyka oraz efekty dźwiękowe jeszcze bardziej budują atmosferę i sprawiają, że trudno oderwać się od ekranu.

Ogromną zaletą jest również współpraca. Bez dobrej komunikacji bardzo trudno ukończyć misje. Każdy gracz może pomóc drużynie, a wspólne planowanie i ratowanie znajomych daje ogromną satysfakcję. Nawet porażki są tutaj świetną zabawą, bo zawsze kończą się śmiesznymi sytuacjami i wspomnieniami.

Twórcy stale rozwijają grę, dodają nowe aktualizacje, poprawiają błędy i słuchają opinii społeczności. Dzięki temu R.E.P.O. cały czas się rozwija i z każdą aktualizacją staje się jeszcze lepsze.

Moim zdaniem R.E.P.O. zasługuje na …

claims.claim: Cosmetic boxes and crates can be found as loot drops during gameplay.

citations.review_text:
Great game. Been playing it for a while and it continues to get better with each update. It has a fun game loop and playing with friends makes it better. I love that the bots can talk and have expressions. The addition of the cosmetic crates has been a lot of fun too. I like that you find the cosmetic crates like loot, and it's not a pay-to-have kind of thing. It's cool once see what everyone gets.
If you're not worried about being a lil bad at it, you can play it with the Steam Deck too.

Very addictive and hilarious game when playing with friends, and cosmetic box hunting gives a good enough reason to keep coming back for more. The game is still in early access at the time of this review, so content in the form of maps and monsters may be lacking, though I have yet to tire from the four available maps and the current roster of enemies. Modding is pretty simple, and is a good way to supplement the experience, but not necessary at all. Performance on current hardware is solid.

Rarely play solo unless I am testing mods to play with others at a later time, so I can understand why it might be hard to get into if you are a solo player or have nobody to play with.

claims.claim: Monsters will specifically target and attack the carts carrying team loot.

citations.review_text:
If you want a horribly balanced, un-rewarding and terrible rng game, this is the game for you. 

Developers recently made the game harder making it a run reset simulator. In the early levels, you don't have the equipment or upgrades to handle enemies (even on level 1). If you've learnt how to play around enemies and survive against them, the developers have kindly made it so the monsters will target the carts with your loot in them instead and ruin your run that way by money starving you. The game you used to be able to enjoy with friends regardless of skill level, but has now is pivoted towards try-hards with no way of lowering the difficulty for the casual player base. 

You want the cosmetics to make your robot look cool? Well prepare to be dissapointed. On the rare occasion you actually find the cosmetic cubes, it will be common box. Majority of the cosmetics aren't worth using. I've played just over 100hrs at this point and i've seen one legendary box (that also was a terrible cosmetic lol). If this is your main drive for playing the game, don't bother purchasing. 

The shop items rng is also horribly designed from the items you can recieve (or the lack their of) to the unfair inflation of item costs. I've had runs where i've seen no lethal guns until round 10, and when playing with friends from across the world where ping and desync is a huge issue, melee items are rendered unusable. There are items that aren't worth their cost regardless of what stage you're at in the game, which will be put into the item rotation in the shop. 

Now here comes the wonderful bugs that plague this game.
- Enemies can damage and kill you through walls. 
- If you have guns in your inventory, theres a chance that when u pull them out you will shoot and/or kill yourself with them (which has happened to me on multiple occasions). 
- I've had friends get stuck in ceilings and walls with no way to revive them.
- When choosing a region to play in on multiplayer, the game will ignore yo…

TRANSLATE
Great game, but some enemies are way too pushy. After the Curse Ghost’s short warning, she locks onto you with almost no counterplay, the Bike Ghost and Crawlers feel to constantly break progress like Harassment, the Screamer Ghost smashing the item cart just cause its in her way is just annoying and ruins runs for no good reason, And the scream is actually too aggressively loud, hurts my ears.

Please maybe consider tweaking these enemies for a less-punishing gameplay?


When the game gets this unfair, players naturally turn to cheats just to keep things balanced.

After the Curse Ghost’s short warning, she locks onto you with almost no counterplay, the Bike Ghost and Crawlers feel to constantly break progress like Harassment, the Screamer Ghost smashing the item cart just cause its in her way is just annoying and ruins runs for no good reason, And the scream is actually too aggressively loud, hurts my ears.

Please maybe consider tweaking these enemies for a less-punishing gameplay?


When the game gets this unfair, players naturally turn to cheats just to keep things balanced.

Genuinely one of my favorite games. Scary on your own, lots of fun with friends, and all around very replayable! Though it can be a bit difficult in the earlier levels, the higher you go, the more satisfying it becomes to complete levels and reach new milestones.
I also am I really, really big fan of the recent cosmetics update, as someone who LOVES collecting things in games. The sheer joy of finding an ultra-rare box after a long stretch of commons and uncommons is like nothing else.
The enemy designs are interesting and fun to play around and against (though I will ALWAYS be the #1 Upscream Hater), and the level designs and the soundtracks to pair with them are beautiful. I really mean it when I say I adore this game.
